recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a later Applied or Published tracker explicitly retires VisionPrescription or changes its OO ownership.
issue_request: FHIR-39279 asked to drop VisionPrescription because DeviceRequest examples could express vision orders. The final Published / Not Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5 retained the resource and moved ownership/custodianship from Financial Management to Orders and Observations.
initial_application: The apparent source application was commit 47a373597dc7b1c66918744f49ec1a241ac0dd56, which changed source/fhir.ini from visionprescription=fm to visionprescription=oo. Current source/fhir.ini still lists VisionPrescription as an active resource and assigns it to OO, and the VisionPrescription StructureDefinition carries the OO work group extension and publisher.
additional_context: FMG minutes for 2023-03-15 identify FHIR-39279 as the ownership transfer from FM to OO and say FM or OO editors could make the R5 change. OO minutes and DeviceRequest source keep the lens examples as overlap examples while stating VisionPrescription has specific lens details. Later Jira FHIR-26948 was Resolved - No Change with a note that VisionPrescription is staying as a separate resource.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Removing VisionPrescription would contradict the final Jira disposition and later related evidence; adding duplicate explanatory prose would not improve the current build because the build metadata and DeviceRequest/VisionPrescription narrative already convey the current state.
